findings.title: CAD layer and foundation geometry are never parsed
findings.body: ExtractFoundationData never uses layerName or inspects instanceGeom. Instead, it creates one FoundationData record for each top-level GeometryInstance using that instance's transform origin and rotation. A CAD import commonly exposes the imported drawing as a top-level GeometryInstance, so this places a foundation at the CAD import origin rather than one at each foundation represented on S-FND; geometry from other layers is also indistinguishable. This prevents the requested auto-placement behavior from working.
